fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Found while surveying the credential-in-argv class for antiviral-agrarian-amurminnow (2026-11-22 PST). Operator-workstation tooling and contributor guidance still put Gerrit credentials on a process command line, where any local user or process monitor can read them while the process runs:
- `infra/gerrit/service-user.sh` (the bot-token rotation tool): `ssh ... gerrit create-account/set-account --http-password "$TOKEN"` (lines 41-55; the new token is in the local ssh argv), `aws ssm put-parameter --value "$TOKEN"` (line 66), and `awk -v tok="$TOKEN"` (line 83).
- `infra/gerrit/smoke-check.sh`, `reviewbot-e2e.sh`, `feature-branch-e2e.sh`, `feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh` and `feature-branch-inventory.sh`: `curl -u "user:$PW"`, and `git clone`/`git push` or `curl` with `https://user:$PW@host` URLs.
- `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml:783,787`: the Jira cleanup's `curl -u "${JIRA_USER}:${JIRA_API_TOKEN}"`.
- `AGENTS.md:90` (the recommended Gerrit REST snippet) and `CONTRIBUTING.md:268-270` teach `curl --user "$user:$password"` / `curl -u "$USER:$PASS"`.

These run on operator hosts, not the review-bot box, so they were kept out of the box-side fix (antiviral-agrarian-amurminnow), which adds a static guard over `src/rebar`; this ticket extends that guard to the files above. service-user.sh is the tool the operator would use to rotate the review-bot token, so fixing it before that rotation keeps the new token out of argv.

## Approach
Root cause: each script builds the credential into a command-line argument (`curl -u user:pw`, `https://user:pw@host` URLs, `ssh ... --http-password <tok>`, `aws ... --value <tok>`, `awk -v tok=<tok>`). A process's argv is readable by every local user through `ps` and `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` for as long as it runs. The fix hands each credential over a channel that is not argv. `printf` is a shell builtin (bash and zsh), so `printf ... | cmd` moves the value through a pipe without starting a process that carries it.

1. New sourced helper `infra/gerrit/lib-credentials.sh` with two functions used by every `infra/gerrit` script:
   - `curl_auth <user> <password> <curl args...>`: escapes `\` and `"`, then `printf 'user = "%s:%s"\n' ... | curl -K - "$@"` (curl's config file read from stdin). Measured locally 2026-11-23: a one-shot HTTP server received the expected `Authorization: Basic` value, including for a password containing `"` and `\`.
   - `git_auth <base-url> <user> <password> <git args...>`: base64-encodes `user:password` through a pipe (`printf | base64 | tr -d '\n'`), then runs git in a subshell with git's own `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`/`GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n>`/`GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n>` environment carrying `credential.helper=` (empty, so the operator's keychain helper is neither asked nor told to erase or store) and `http.<base-url>/.extraHeader = Authorization: Basic ...`, appended after any inherited entries, plus `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`. This is the same mechanism antiviral-agrarian-amurminnow uses on the box (commit 053604a2618). It uses only git-defined environment variables and adds no rebar env var, config key or flag.
2. `infra/gerrit/service-user.sh` (rotation tool):
   - `create-account` no longer takes `--http-password`. For both a new and an existing account, the script deletes the `default` token (as today) and then runs `gerrit set-account <bot> --generate-http-password`. Gerrit 3.14.1 (the deployed image, `infra/compose/Dockerfile.gerrit:5`) generates the password server-side and prints `New password: <pw>` on stdout (Gerrit 3.14.1 cmd-set-account documentation). The script captures it from ssh's stdout without echoing it, strips the prefix and any CR, and fails closed (exit 1, value not printed) unless the result is non-empty and only `[A-Za-z0-9+/=._~-]`. The local `openssl rand` generation is removed. All consumers of `/rebar/prod/gerrit-bot-token` send it in a header (`gerrit_client._auth` Basic, `X-Rebar-Token`) or in the 0600 env file (`infra/scripts/fetch-secrets.sh`), so the base64 character set needs no URL encoding.
   - SSM: `printf '%s' "$TOKEN" | aws ssm put-parameter ... --value file:///dev/stdin`. Measured 2026-11-23 with AWS CLI 2.39.7 using a read-only `get-parameter --name file:///dev/stdin`: the request body carried the name read from stdin.
   - The webhooks template render replaces `awk -v tok=...` with a bash `while read` loop and `${line//__BOT_TOKEN__/$TOKEN}`. No process starts, so the token is in neither argv nor any child environment. The character check above excludes `&` and `\`, so bash 5.2's `patsub_replacement` cannot alter it.
3. `smoke-check.sh`, `reviewbot-e2e.sh`, `feature-branch-e2e.sh`, `feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh` and `feature-branch-inventory.sh` source the helper. Every `curl -u` becomes `curl_auth`. The 2 URL-userinfo git calls (smoke-check clone, scenario 7 non-member push) become `git_auth` with a userinfo-free URL. The reviewbot-e2e commit-msg hook download uses `curl_auth`, not a `user:token@` URL.
4. `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml` Jira cleanup (lines 783, 787): `printf 'user = "%s:%s"\n' "$JIRA_USER" "$JIRA_API_TOKEN" | curl -K - ...`.
5. Docs: `AGENTS.md` (the Gerrit `/a/` snippet) and `CONTRIBUTING.md` (`/wip`, `/ready`) use `printf 'user = "%s:%s"\n' ... | curl --config - ...`. `infra/runbooks/gerrit-auth-hardening.md:120` uses the same form. In the same class, also fixed: `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md:152` (`X-Rebar-Token` header via `curl -K -` `header = ...`), `infra/runbooks/g2p-ci-credentials.md:97` and `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md:443` (`--value file://<keyfile>` in place of `--value "$(cat <keyfile>)"`), and `infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md:131` (generated secret piped to `--value file:///dev/stdin`).
6. Out of scope, filed as limitless-defaceable-beaver (discovered_from this ticket): `docs/mcp-client-setup.md` puts the MCP client PAT in `copilot`/`claude mcp add --header` argv. It is a different credential, and its fix depends on each vendor CLI's `${VAR}` expansion. The guard names it in a single exclusion that cites that ticket. The IMDSv2 `X-aws-ec2-metadata-token` session headers in on-instance scripts are excluded by pattern: they are short-lived instance-local session tokens, not Gerrit or Jira credentials.

## Scope
- `infra/gerrit/lib-credentials.sh` (new), `infra/gerrit/service-user.sh`, `infra/gerrit/smoke-check.sh`, `infra/gerrit/reviewbot-e2e.sh`, `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e.sh`, `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh`, `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-inventory.sh`
- `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml`
- `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `infra/runbooks/gerrit-auth-hardening.md`, `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md`, `infra/runbooks/g2p-ci-credentials.md`, `infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md`, `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md`
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_git_credential_argv.py` (extend the static guard), `tests/scripts/test_operator_credential_argv.py` (new behavioural tests), `tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py` (its curl stub must accept `-K -`)
- Not touched: `src/rebar` (no product code change), no token rotation, `service-user.sh` is not run.

## Testing
- Static guard (extends the antiviral-agrarian-amurminnow test): scans `infra/**/*.sh`, `infra/**/*.md`, `scripts/**/*.sh`, `.github/workflows/*.y*ml`, `docs/**/*.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` for `-u`/`--user` with a `$`/`<` password, URL userinfo with a `$`/`<` password, `--http-password`, `--value "$(cat|openssl ...)"` or `--value "$<secret-named var>"`, `awk -v x="$<secret var>"`, and an auth/token `-H`/`--header` built from a variable. A self-test asserts each pattern flags its target shape and passes the fixed shape. Before the fix it reports the 27 known hits; after the fix it reports none.
- Behavioural, `service-user.sh` run end to end against PATH stubs for `ssh`, `aws` and `git` that record argv. The ssh stub answers `--generate-http-password` with a known password; the git stub makes `diff --cached --quiet` fail so the commit/push path runs and copies the rendered `webhooks.config` out. The test uses a template copy containing `__BOT_TOKEN__`. Assertions: the password is in no recorded argv; aws received it exactly on stdin with `--value file:///dev/stdin`; the rendered file contains it; create path and rotate path both covered. Failure cases: malformed generator output (extra text, a space, an `&`) exits non-zero, never calls aws, and never prints the value.
- Behavioural, helpers: `curl_auth` and `git_auth` against recording stubs. The secret appears in no argv; curl's stdin holds a `user = "..."` line that round-trips `"` and `\`; git's env holds `credential.helper` empty and the URL-scoped `extraHeader` after an inherited `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1` entry. A malformed inherited count falls back to 0. Real `git config --get-urlmatch` resolves the header for the Gerrit URL and not for `https://github.com/...`.
- Existing `tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py`, `tests/unit/test_codex_agent_guidance.py`, `tests/unit/test_wip_hold_guidance.py`, `tests/unit/test_external_integration_cloud_mutation_workflow.py` keep passing (the inventory curl stub is updated to drain `-K -` stdin).
- Shell tests carry the existing `requires_posix_shell` marker. `make verify` before push.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `infra/gerrit/service-user.sh` passes the new token to `aws ssm put-parameter` and to the webhooks template render without it appearing in any argv (for example `--value file://` from a pipe, and `ENVIRON` in awk), and sets the Gerrit HTTP password without it appearing in the local ssh argv (for example server-side generation, or the REST endpoint with the body on stdin).
- [ ] The Gerrit REST examples in `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` pass the credential through `curl -K` from a pipe (or another channel that is not argv), not `-u`/`--user`.
- [ ] The static guard test added by antiviral-agrarian-amurminnow covers these files and passes.
